events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place in Bethel, New York, in 1969.

angles.name: The Sound of '69
angles.copy: 57 years since the mud, music, and peace of Woodstock. What's your top track from the legendary festival?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: This date marks the anniversary of the passing of the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Elvis Presley today. His legacy continues to inspire generations.

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: This date marks the anniversary of the tragic passing of hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact and lyrical genius of Tupac Shakur today. His music still resonates.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: This date marks the anniversary of the passing of legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work changed music forever.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever with The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll attitude.

events.title: 'Imagine' Release Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic song 'Imagine' was released in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine The Message
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A timeless message of peace and hope that still resonates today.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first-generation iPod, revolutionising portable music, in 2001.

angles.name: Music In Your Pocket
angles.copy: Remember the day music truly became portable? 25 years since Apple dropped the first iPod and changed how we listen forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: We remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: 'The White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: The Iconic White Album
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece – what's your standout track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: This date marks the anniversary of the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury today. His voice and stage presence remain legendary.
